name: LCM
description: Least common multiple (LCM) of two numbers is the smallest positive integer which is divisible by both of them. You are given integers a and b . Calculate their LCM.
input_specification: The input contains two integers a and b ( 1 ≤ a , b ≤ 10 3 ), separated by a single space.
approach_summary: Precompute linear sieve to store minimum prime factor (spf[x]) up to N in O(N). Factorize any number x ≤ N in O(log x) steps.
